expected_behavior_change: V3 Admin can authenticate through the existing challenge/verify contract without sending raw PIN.
V3 holds the Admin session token in memory only and removes canonical Query data on logout.
V3 reads and validates the formal Cloud canonical Admin envelope through TanStack Query.
V3 visibly presents canonical metadata and catalog counts in read-only mode.
A reusable V3 CI gate replaces the A0-specific workflow name while retaining zero-production-routing checks.
non_goals: No Admin config edit or publish.
No mutation or Dexie outbox command.
No SMT ACK/projection read in A1.
No backend or v2 runtime code change.
No V3 production deploy, hostname or cutover.
